counterparties.title: Counterparties
counterparties.description: Buyers, suppliers, banks and government bodies.
counterparties.emptyBody: Add a buyer or supplier so you can link expenses and sales to them.
counterparties.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the list.

journal.title: Transactions
journal.description: Every receipt and payment, with its date, amount, account and cost center.
journal.addHint: Date, account and cost center are remembered for the next entry.
journal.emptyBody: Enter the first expense or income, or change the filters.
journal.deleteBody: The unapproved entry will be removed. The change stays in the audit history.
journal.fxHint: Leave empty to use the nearest rate from the rates table.

treatmentHint.expense: Charged to the chosen cost center straight away.
treatmentHint.inventory: Goes into stock. It reaches cost only when issued, so it is never counted twice.
treatmentHint.capex: A fixed asset. It reaches cost gradually, through depreciation.
treatmentHint.animal: Added to the animal's own value, not to herd expenses.

approval.emptyBody: Expenses above the set amount land here.
approval.ownEntry: You entered this one, so someone else has to approve it.
approval.ownVoid: You entered this one, so someone else has to void it.

accounts.title: Cash and bank
accounts.description: Cash, bank accounts and daily balances.
accounts.statementHint: Money in and out per day, and the closing balance.
accounts.closeBody: "{{name}}" will leave the list. Its history is kept.
accounts.emptyBody: Add a cash desk or a bank account to start tracking money.

fields.name: Name
fields.openingHint: Transactions before this date count as already in the balance.

fx.description: Foreign-currency transactions convert to so'm at these rates.
fx.addHint: One rate per day. Saving a day again corrects it.
fx.emptyBody: Add a USD, EUR or RUB rate for imported purchases.

debts.title: Debts
debts.description: Who owes us, whom we owe, and when it is due.
debts.amountInAccountCurrency: Enter the amount in the account's currency ({{currency}}). It is converted at the stored rate.
debts.pendingSettlement: A payment of {{amount}} is waiting for approval.
debts.emptyBody: Purchases and sales on credit appear here.

unpaidReceipts.hint: Goods came from a supplier, but no payment or debt is recorded for them yet.
unpaidReceipts.paidRequest: A paid purchase request is still waiting for these goods. If this is that delivery, it is paid already: recording it here would count it twice.
unpaidReceipts.categoryHint: Some goods here have no category of their own. This one is used for the whole receipt.
unpaidReceipts.empty: Every receipt has its money recorded
unpaidReceipts.emptyBody: A purchase received with no payment or debt appears here.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Plan, actual and variance by category and month.
budget.addCategory: Add a category to the plan
budget.chartHint: Stock purchases count in the month they were bought: a budget controls spending.
budget.emptyBody: Enter the plan by month and the variance against actuals shows right away.

costs.title: Cost and profitability
costs.description: What each herd, field and cost center really costs.
costs.head: Head
costs.breakdownTitle: What the cost is made of
costs.noHerdsBody: Once a herd exists, its cost is worked out here.
costs.noFieldsBody: Assign a crop to a field and its cost appears here.
costs.centerChartHint: Fields and herds, after machinery and overhead are shared out.
costs.noDataBody: Figures appear once expenses are entered or stock is issued.
costs.internalNote: Own produce, such as alfalfa, moves to the herd at an internal price, so the sum of centers can exceed what the farm really paid. For the farm's bottom line, use the Categories tab.

cashflow.title: Cash flow
cashflow.description: Expected money in, money out and balance by month.
cashflow.gapBody: Months short of cash: {{n}}. Deepest gap: {{amount}}. Plan ahead: delay spending, bring sales forward, or arrange short-term financing.
cashflow.methodNote: This is a statistical forecast, not a promise. It rests on the budget, {{months}} months of history, the loan schedule and debt due dates.
cashflow.beyondPlan: The budget runs to {{month}}. Later months show only loan and debt payments, so they are not a forecast.
cashflow.lowConfidenceBody: There is no budget and under three months of history, so this forecast only reflects loans and debt due dates. Enter a budget.
cashflow.balanceChartHint: Any month below zero is a month short of cash.
cashflow.flowChart: Money in and out by month
cashflow.detailHint: What this month's figures are made of.
cashflow.actualHint: Transfers between own accounts and credit transactions are left out.
cashflow.emptyBody: Approved transactions appear here by month.

loans.title: Loans and leasing
loans.description: Loans, payment schedules, interest and what is still owed.
loans.addHint: The payment schedule is built from the terms automatically.
loans.payHint: Principal {{principal}} and interest {{interest}}. Interest is recorded as an expense.
loans.overdueBody: Pay it soon to avoid a late-payment penalty.
loans.emptyBody: Once added, loan payments feed the calendar and the cash-flow forecast.
loans.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its schedule will be deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.disburseHint: If chosen, the loan money is recorded into this account.

errors.WAGES_PAID_FROM_PAYROLL: Wages are paid from the payroll run under Staff, not from here.
errors.TRANSACTION_CHANGED: This entry was changed after you opened it. It now reads {{amount}} {{currency}}. Nothing was saved: read it again, then decide.
errors.ACCOUNT_CLOSED: This account is closed. Choose another one.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: This account holds a different currency.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_EMPTY: This account still holds {{balance}}. Move the money out first.
errors.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Choose a cash or bank account.
errors.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DEBT: That is more than the debt. Up to {{outstanding}} can be settled.
errors.CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: This category does not fit the transaction type.
errors.COST_CENTER_CLOSED: This cost center is closed. Choose another one.
errors.DEBT_ALREADY_SETTLED: A payment already covers this debt. Cancel the payment first.
errors.FX_RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This rate is too far from the stored rate of {{stored}}. Check it, or correct the stored rate.
errors.FX_RATE_REQUIRED: There is no exchange rate for this date. Enter one.
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD: This payment method does not fit the transaction.
errors.LOAN_HAS_PAYMENTS: A loan with payments or received money cannot be deleted.
errors.NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved transaction can be voided.
errors.NOT_PENDING: This transaction is not waiting for approval.
errors.RECEIPT_HAS_MONEY: Money is already recorded for this receipt.
errors.SAME_MAKER_CHECKER: The person who entered a transaction cannot approve it.
errors.SETTLEMENT_NOT_EDITABLE: A debt payment cannot be edited. Delete it and enter it again.
errors.TRANSACTION_APPROVED: An approved transaction cannot be changed. Void it instead.
errors.TRANSACTION_HAS_SOURCE: This entry came from another module. Change it there.
errors.TRANSACTION_REJECTED: A rejected or voided transaction stays in the journal. Enter a new one.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_LOCKED: This account already holds money, so its currency cannot change.
